name: Rising
audio: a thunderous eruption, roaring flame and a rising brass-like swell; no speech
world: The caldera is alive: lava arcs and falls, embers and ash swirl, fire salamanders scurry across the rocks, ash birds wheel overhead and the sky flickers orange.

actions.beat: The lava lake bulges and cracks, the volcano rumbling as fountains of fire arc into the sky; fire salamanders scatter across the rocks.
{{She}} bursts upward out of the lava on a surging column of molten rock, arms flung wide, back arched, hair and ribbons streaming straight up behind {{her}}.

The lava streams off {{her}} in glowing curtains and falls back into the lake as {{she}} lands lightly on the rising rock, {{her}} eyes igniting with {{MAGIC}} fire and a fierce, exhilarated look to the camera.

notes: THE DAWN, in motion: the sister rises from the Sundering in her homeland, the world moving around her.
